description: List competitive pilot rounds on one of your OpenTrain WorkProjects: status (RUNNING/DECIDED/CLOSED), masked participants, sample size, winner. A pilot round has N suppliers label the SAME sample, scored on the same basis, so the buyer can pick who to scale with. Requires open-label:read scope.

projectId.description: Work project id to list pilot rounds for.

name: opentrain_list_pilot_rounds
